description: A PHP class providing utilities for working with Drupal's composer.json and composer.lock files, including loading data, retrieving require-dev sections, and package info.

classes.name: DrupalCoreComposer
classes.description: A utility class for managing and retrieving data from Drupal's composer.json and composer.lock files.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the class with composer.json and composer.lock data.

methods.name: createFromPath
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance from a directory path containing composer files.

methods.name: rootComposerJson
methods.description: Returns the composer.json data for the root project.

methods.name: packageLockInfo
methods.description: Looks up package information in composer.lock by package name, optionally considering only dev packages.
